name: GraphHopper Directions API
summary: Routing, distance matrices, isochrones and geocoding on OpenStreetMap data.

api_key.description: a GraphHopper API key (graphhopper.com dashboard > API keys)

notes: Billed in credits against a daily limit. Each response's X-RateLimit-Credits header gives the cost of that call and X-RateLimit-Remaining the credits left before it; 429 means the daily or per-minute limit is spent.
Points are 'latitude,longitude' in requests, and multi-value parameters repeat (point=..&point=..); pass a list.
The free package supports only the car, bike and foot profiles.

endpoints.name: Calculate a route
endpoints.summary: Distance, time, geometry and turn-by-turn instructions between two or more points.

point.description: Points as 'latitude,longitude', origin first, destination last, vias between. Sent as repeated point parameters; the maximum count depends on the plan.

profile.description: Vehicle profile; default car. Free plan: car, bike, foot only. Others include car_avoid_motorway, car_avoid_ferry, car_avoid_toll, small_truck, truck, scooter, hike, mtb, racingbike, or a custom profile id (cp_...).

locale.description: Language of instructions, e.g. 'de' or 'pt_PT'; default en.

calc_points.description: Return the route geometry; default true.

points_encoded.description: Default true (polyline-encoded). false returns plain [lon, lat] coordinates.

elevation.description: Add altitude as a third coordinate; default false.

details.description: Path details to return, e.g. street_name, road_class, surface, max_speed, toll, time, distance.

optimize.description: 'true' lets the service reorder via points to minimise time; costs more credits. Not with ch.disable=true.

point_hint.description: A road name per point to snap it to; none or one per point.

snap_prevention.description: Road types not to snap points to: motorway, trunk, ferry, tunnel, bridge, ford.

curbside.description: Per point: any, right or left; for all points or none.

algorithm.description: Solve a different problem: several near-optimal routes, or a round trip from the first point.

round_trip_distance.description: Approximate length of a round trip in metres; default 10000.

round_trip_seed.description: Random seed; change it for a different round trip.

notes: Coordinates in the response are [longitude, latitude] (GeoJSON order), the reverse of the point parameter.

endpoints.name: Geocode an address or place
endpoints.summary: Places matching a text query, with coordinates, address parts and OSM ids.

q.description: The address or place to look for.

locale.description: Result language; the default provider supports en, fr, es, de, pt, ru, it. Default en.

provider.description: Geocoder to use; default 'default'. Alternatives such as nominatim are under development and may fall back to default.

notes: The default provider does prefix matching, tuned for autocomplete.

endpoints.name: Reverse geocode a point
endpoints.summary: Addresses and places near a coordinate.

reverse.description: Must be true for reverse geocoding.

notes: Do not send q with reverse=true.

endpoints.name: Compute a distance/time matrix
endpoints.summary: Travel times, distances or weights between every origin and destination.

profile.description: Vehicle profile; default car. Free plan: car, bike, foot only. Others include car_avoid_motorway, car_avoid_ferry, car_avoid_toll, small_truck, truck, scooter, hike, mtb, racingbike, or a custom profile id (cp_...).

point.description: Points as 'latitude,longitude' that are both origins and destinations (N points give N x N entries). Or use from_point and to_point.

out_array.description: Which matrices to return: weights, times, distances.

fail_fast.description: Error as soon as a point cannot be found or connected; default true. false returns null entries instead.

notes: Large matrices use the async POST /matrix/calculate flow instead (not in this entry).

endpoints.name: Compute an isochrone
endpoints.summary: Polygons of everywhere reachable from a point within a travel time or distance.

profile.description: Vehicle profile; default car. Free plan: car, bike, foot only. Others include car_avoid_motorway, car_avoid_ferry, car_avoid_toll, small_truck, truck, scooter, hike, mtb, racingbike, or a custom profile id (cp_...).

distance_limit.description: Travel distance in metres, instead of time_limit.

buckets.description: Split the limit into this many nested polygons; default 1.

reverse_flow.description: true for the area that can reach the point, false (default) for the area reachable from it.
